_doc: pipeline/indirect_targets.py on the analysed build: every indirect call and jump with its targets and the source of each (see the script's docstring). RECORDED TARGETS ARE OBSERVED, NOT PROVEN COMPLETE: a site with status "recorded" may also go elsewhere. Only "static" target sets are complete.

_sources.static: vcall_resolve.py (data/vcalls.json): every vtable the object can have at the call, the callee in that slot of each; the complete set
_sources.com: com_calls.py (data/com_calls.json): a method of a proven Direct3D 8 interface (d3d8.h, data/com_spec.json)
_sources.com_accepted: com_calls.py on the accepted declaration CDx+0xC (data/com_fields.json device_via_CDx_this): ACCEPTED, NOT PROVEN
_sources.recorded: the running game (xikit facts=1, data/game_sp.json / game_switch.json), at analysed addresses (xikit.c analysed_of); observed, not proven complete

_reasons.vc_flow: vcall_resolve: the function's this-flow is not followed (an indirect jump that is not a bounded switch)
_reasons.vc_unreached: vcall_resolve: the this-flow walk does not reach the call (code after an unfollowed jump)
_reasons.vc_base: vcall_resolve: the pointer is not loaded from `this`'s [+0] (another object, or a function pointer in a field); com_calls.py: not a proven Direct3D 8 object either
_reasons.vc_top: vcall_resolve: this may be any object (the method's address is taken, or a caller passes another object)
_reasons.vc_none: vcall_resolve: method reached by no vtable and no caller
_reasons.vc_past: vcall_resolve: slot past a vtable end
_reasons.reg: call through a register: no tool here settles the register's value
_reasons.indexed: call through an indexed operand ([reg + reg*n + disp]): no tool here settles it
_reasons.data_ptr: call through a function pointer in writable data (.data): no tool here settles its value at the call
_reasons.ro_ptr: call through a pointer in a read-only section, outside the import table: not settled here (the section flags are not taken as proof that nothing writes it)
_reasons.jmp_switch: switch jump whose index the code before it does not bound (sp_solve.switch_targets)
_reasons.jmp_other: indirect jump (not a switch through a table): no tool here settles it; it also stops vcall_resolve's flow for its whole function (vc_flow at that function's calls)

_not_recorded.asked: listed for measuring (data/facts_wanted.json), no observation in data/game_sp.json / game_switch.json
_not_recorded.never_asked: never listed for a facts=1 session
